newProject.source: SAEngine practice: 25 psf of floor finishes, ceiling and services and 30 psf on the roof, round psf near the default pack's 1.2 and 1.5 kN/m² (ASCE 7-22 gives no such allowance: the superimposed dead loads are the engineer's, Sec 3.1)

rows.name: Handrails and guards: 50 lb/ft along the top in any direction (with 200 lb at any point, not concurrent)
Vehicle barrier systems for passenger vehicles: 6000 lb horizontal in any direction, on a 12 in x 12 in area at 18 in to 27 in above the floor

sources.barriers: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.5.1.1: handrails and guards 50 lb/ft (0.73 kN/m) and 200 lb (0.89 kN), not concurrent; one- and two-family dwellings and factory, industrial and storage areas of at most 50 occupants need only the 200 lb (choose no line-load row there). Sec 4.5.3: vehicle barriers 6000 lb (26.70 kN) on 12 in x 12 in (305 mm) at the most severe height of 18-27 in (686 mm taken). ASCE 7 has no ramp or long-ramp rule: share 1.0 and factor 1.0 leave the force unchanged.
sources.concentratedPatch: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.4: the concentrated loads of Table 4.3-1 on 2.5 ft x 2.5 ft (762 mm) unless stated, not with the uniform load
sources.partitions: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.3.2: a partition load of at least 15 psf (0.72 kN/m²) where partitions may be moved, not required where the live load is 80 psf or more (not applied by SAEngine: the allowance stays as entered); share 0.33 and lightMax 5.5 kN/m for drawn light partitions are SAEngine practice inherited from the BNBC rule (ASCE 7 gives no such rule)
sources.impact: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.6.2-4.6.3: elevators 100 % (ASME A17.1), machinery 20 % / 50 %, hangers 33 %
